headings: Placing Customer Places a Sales Order - Through EBay
text: For credit card payment the order is placed on eBay and Placing Customer calls eBay Marketer and gives CC#. eBay Marketer either enters entire order including payment information manually, or finds the order already imported from eBay and adds payment information to the order, and then authorizes the payment.
